import numpy as np, json, requests, collections
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session()
def seqof(a): return S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()['sequence']['value']
SEQ=dict(wPHB1=seqof('Q9BKU4'), wPHB2=seqof('P50093'), hPHB1=seqof('P35232'), hPHB2=seqof('Q99623'))
B62_txt="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
AAL=B62_txt.split('\n')[0].split(); AIDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAL)}
MAT=np.full((25,25),-4.0)
for line in B62_txt.split('\n')[1:]:
    p=line.split()
    for j,v in enumerate(p[1:]): MAT[AIDX[p[0]],AIDX[AAL[j]]]=int(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([AIDX.get(c,-1) for c in s])
def nw_pos(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    Mp=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Xp=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Yp=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    PM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); PX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); PY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mp[0,0]=0; Xp[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); PX[1:,0]=1; Yp[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m); PY[0,1:]=2
    e2c=np.clip(e2,0,24)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        srow=MAT[max(e1[i-1],0)][e2c]
        cand=np.vstack([Mp[i-1,:-1],Xp[i-1,:-1],Yp[i-1,:-1]])+srow
        k=np.argmax(cand,0); Mp[i,1:]=cand[k,np.arange(m)]; PM[i,1:]=k
        cand=np.vstack([Mp[i-1,1:]+go, Xp[i-1,1:]+ge]); k=np.argmax(cand,0); Xp[i,1:]=cand[k,np.arange(m)]; PX[i,1:]=k
        mi=Mp[i]; yi=Yp[i]; pyi=PY[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=mi[j-1]+go; b=yi[j-1]+ge
            if a>=b: yi[j]=a; pyi[j]=0
            else: yi[j]=b; pyi[j]=1
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([Mp[n,m],Xp[n,m],Yp[n,m]])); out={}
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: out[i]=j; st=PM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: st=PX[i,j]; i-=1
        else: st=PY[i,j]; j-=1
    return out

CLASS=json.load(open('res_classes.json'))
cons={'PHB1':np.load('consF_PHB1.npy'),'PHB2':np.load('consF_PHB2.npy')}
res={}
tab=[]
for hk,wk,ck in [('hPHB1','wPHB1','PHB1'),('hPHB2','wPHB2','PHB2')]:
    mp=nw_pos(SEQ[hk],SEQ[wk])   # human pos -> worm pos
    by=collections.defaultdict(list); byid=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for hpos_s,info in CLASS[hk].items():
        hpos=int(hpos_s)
        if hpos not in mp: continue
        w=mp[hpos]; c=cons[ck][w-1]
        if np.isnan(c): continue
        by[info['cls']].append(c)
        byid[info['cls']].append(1.0 if SEQ[hk][hpos-1]==SEQ[wk][w-1] else 0.0)
    print(f"\n=== {hk} -> C. elegans {wk}: nematode conservation by structural class ===")
    for c in ['membrane belt','subunit interface','buried core','lumen-facing','outer-facing']:
        v=np.array(by[c]); i=np.array(byid[c])
        print(f"  {c:20s} n={len(v):4d}  nematode per-position identity {v.mean():5.1f}% (median {np.median(v):5.1f})  human=worm at {100*i.mean():5.1f}% of sites")
        tab.append(dict(subunit=hk,cls=c,n=len(v),nem=float(v.mean()),hw=float(100*i.mean())))
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(by['membrane belt'], by['lumen-facing'], alternative='greater')
    u2,p2=mannwhitneyu(by['subunit interface'], by['lumen-facing'], alternative='greater')
    print(f"  Mann-Whitney membrane belt > lumen-facing: U={u:.0f}, p={p:.2e}")
    print(f"  Mann-Whitney subunit interface > lumen-facing: U={u2:.0f}, p={p2:.2e}")
    res[hk]=dict(p_belt_vs_lumen=float(p), p_iface_vs_lumen=float(p2))
json.dump({'table':tab,'tests':res}, open('conservation_by_class.json','w'), indent=1)

# figure
import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(tab)
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,4.6), sharey=True)
order=['membrane belt','subunit interface','buried core','lumen-facing','outer-facing']
for a_,hk in zip(axs,['hPHB1','hPHB2']):
    s=df[df.subunit==hk].set_index('cls').loc[order]
    x=np.arange(len(order))
    a_.bar(x-0.2, s['nem'], 0.4, label='mean identity across 62-16 nematode species')
    a_.bar(x+0.2, s['hw'], 0.4, label='% sites identical human vs C. elegans')
    for i,(n) in enumerate(s['n']): a_.text(i, 3, f"n={n}", ha='center', fontsize=8)
    a_.set_xticks(x); a_.set_xticklabels(order, rotation=25, ha='right')
    a_.set_title(f"{'PHB-1' if hk=='hPHB1' else 'PHB-2'} residues, classified in the assembled bell (9O9Z)")
    a_.grid(alpha=.3, axis='y')
axs[0].set_ylabel('% identity'); axs[0].legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
